title: Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee Program Terms Across the Closing Cost Credit Schedule
content:
The Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee is the one Larkspur Closing Cost Credit program with guarantee terms. The schedule carries the terms for every program, and the six other programs carry zeros and no excluded causes.

| Credit program | Enrollment window (business days after the application date) | Minimum calendar days from application date to contract closing date | Document deadline (calendar days before the guaranteed closing date) | Causes of a late closing that never trigger a payout | Payout delivered as |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit | 0 | 0 | 0 | none | not applicable |
| Larkspur Returning Customer Credit | 0 | 0 | 0 | none | not applicable |
| Larkspur First Home Credit | 0 | 0 | 0 | none | not applicable |
| Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee | 5 | 21 | 10 | borrower documents late; borrower-requested change; seller or builder delay; title or settlement agent delay; appraised value below contract price; natural disaster | lender credit at closing |
| Larkspur Builder Partner Credit | 0 | 0 | 0 | none | not applicable |
| Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant | 0 | 0 | 0 | none | not applicable |
| Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant Plus | 0 | 0 | 0 | none | not applicable |

### Terms

- **Enrollment window** — business days after the application date within which the guarantee must be enrolled; 0 where the program is not a guarantee.
- **Minimum days to contract closing** — the minimum number of calendar days between the application date and the contract closing date for enrollment in the guarantee.
- **Document deadline** — the number of calendar days before the guaranteed closing date by which the borrower must deliver every requested document.
- **Excluded causes** — causes of a late closing that never trigger a payout.
- **Payout delivered as** — how a payout is delivered: as a lender credit at closing.

### Reading the terms (hypothetical)

For the guarantee, an application dated on a Monday leaves an enrollment window of 5 business days after it; a contract closing date 21 calendar days after the application date meets the minimum, and one 20 calendar days after it does not.
